name: starter-p2-local-dry-van-hourly
about: Starter P2 "The number" on the opening-local-dry-van-hourly brief (the owner's copy rating, 2026-11-12).

brief.subject: Class A local dry van driver

recipe.name: The number
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with the pay figure alone, exactly as the brief states it and with its unit (per mile, per week, per year). If the brief states no pay, lead with its strongest other figure (a bonus, home days, miles) — never a figure the brief does not hold. Who the job is for (the licence, the kind of run) goes in a few words on the small line above it, never in the pay line.
recipe.image_prompt_template: A plain {surface} background, {texture}, {light}, a soft {tone} gradient, nothing in the frame, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: 360 Logistics is hiring local dry van drivers for dedicated Chicagoland store deliveries. You earn $28 to $32 per hour, sleep in your own bed every night, and build your days around a consistent local run. Paid time off included. Class A required, age 23+, 2 years experience.
en.headline: Home daily, dedicated route

es.primary_text: 360 Logistics contrata choferes de van seca para entregas locales en Chicago. Ganas de $28 a $32 por hora, regresas a casa a diario en ruta dedicada. Incluye tiempo libre pagado. Se requiere Clase A, mayores de 23 años y 2 años de experiencia.
es.headline: A casa cada día, ruta fija
